2026-09-01.title: Be Honest About It All
2026-09-01.verse: For foreigners attack me; ruthless men, who do not respect God, seek my life. (Selah) Look, God is my deliverer. The Lord is among those who support me.
2026-09-01.observation: Counselors say that we all have a tendency to make something bigger than it is in our minds. We also have a tendency to major on the bad and not the good. This passage reminds us that it is important to be honest about both. The songwriter is being honest about the enemies he faces. He says they are up to bad things for bad reasons. Then, he also says that God is good. God is his helper. Therefore, He will always be with us, too.
2026-09-01.application: Remember the Lord is bigger than any battle we face.
2026-09-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being bigger than our battles.

2026-09-02.title: Make God an Active Part of Your Life
2026-09-02.verse: As for me, I will call out to God, and the Lord will deliver me. During the evening, morning, and noontime I will lament and moan, and he will hear me.
2026-09-02.observation: In today’s song, David says he has made God part of his life by crying out to Him continually. In another song, there is talk of praising God seven times a day. The point is to see ourselves making our relationship part of our everyday life. I heard someone once say that you didn’t have to tell them what you valued. He said all he needed to do was to look at your calendar and your bank account and he would find out all he needed to know. We say we value God, but do we make Him a part of our everyday life? When we don’t make someone an active part of our lives, we slowly grow distant from one another. I have watched this happen with people who are great friends, then one of them moves away. Most of the time, the friendship only lasts a little while longer. Eventually, as they fill their schedules with other things, the friendship begins to cool. We must fight to keep God an active part of our daily life so our relationship with Him does not cool.
2026-09-02.application: Make an appointment with God every day and keep it.
2026-09-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being good company. Your Word is alive. Prayer is powerful. Thank You.

2026-09-03.title: Don’t Deny Fear, Embrace the Lord
2026-09-03.verse: When I am afraid, I trust in you.
2026-09-03.observation: The songwriter does something that is a powerful act of agency. He admits that fear is a constant in our lives. To deny the presence of fear does nothing other than create anxiety. We still feel fear, but we do not have a way to name what brings us fear and take steps toward moving forward. However, when we state that fear is there, we can take the next step. The songwriter says when fear is acknowledged, it is important to also acknowledge that God is present. We never experience fear alone or without the presence of God. That does not remove fear, but it does remove the sense of powerlessness. We realize that the only one who can do anything about it is walking with us. We trust the Lord will be with us in all things. This takes the teeth out of fear and makes it another opportunity for us to walk more closely with the Lord.
2026-09-03.application: Take a moment and name whatever you are afraid of today. Then, take a moment to give it to the Lord.
2026-09-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every fearful season.

2026-09-04.title: God is Faithful
2026-09-04.verse: For your loyal love extends beyond the sky, and your faithfulness reaches the clouds.
2026-09-04.observation: Everyone needs what is called a “3 am friend.” This is a faithful friend. They are the type of person that, if called at 3 am, they will answer and be there as soon as possible. They don’t ask questions, they just ask for a location. These friends are hard to find. God is like this but infinitely more. God will never tell you to wait till morning. The Lord never says He is too busy. He never has to check His schedule. He never gives up when we don’t reciprocate. He is always faithful. He is always good. There are many things in life that are uncertain. God is not one of them. He is always and forever faithful.
2026-09-04.application: Take a moment and celebrate the fact you never have to wonder if God hears you. In your lowest moment, He is there.
2026-09-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being there.

2026-09-05.title: Trust God's Justice
2026-09-05.verse: The godly will rejoice when they see vengeance carried out; they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked. Then observers will say, “Yes indeed, the godly are rewarded. Yes indeed, there is a God who judges in the earth.
2026-09-05.observation: The book of Psalms is filled with songwriters talking about justice and the need for God to act. As a leader, I hear people say they don't want strong leadership until chaos comes close to their home. I've heard people say the same about parenting. I have watched parents talk about the joy of just letting their kids do whatever they want and "explore their world." They say this as though it is the right way to go. Meanwhile, the other people in the room are the victims of their "exploration." There is nothing wrong with giving people room to explore and learn the world around them, but God is the one who set up boundaries and rules. Look at the first five books of the Bible. These rules and regulations were to keep people free from bondage to each other and in right standing with Him. When things are violated, our hearts cry out for justice. That is why today's passage is a blessing. It reminds us that it is okay to seek justice and to know that it will come from the one place where justice is fair for all.
2026-09-05.application: Do the best you can, but trust God to bring justice in His timing.
2026-09-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for making all things right in the end.

2026-09-06.title: What To Do When Treated Unfairly
2026-09-06.verse: They return in the evening; they growl like dogs and prowl around outside the city. Look, they hurl insults at me and openly threaten to kill me, for they say, “Who hears?” But you, O Lord, laugh in disgust at them; you taunt all the nations. You are my source of strength. I will wait for you. For God is my refuge. The God who loves me will help me; God will enable me to triumph over my enemies.
2026-09-06.observation: I love the honesty in the Bible. This songwriter is talking about something all of us have faced from time to time. We have all faced moments when we feel unjustly treated by those around us. The result is feeling as though all the world is against us. However, the good news is we are never alone. Just like the psalmist, we can turn everything over to the Lord, talk to Him about our troubles, and wait on His deliverance. This doesn't mean we don't do our best to get out of any difficulty we have found ourselves in. The main thing is we realize that all good things come from the Lord. The One who loves us most is on the throne and is working in our lives. Therefore, we never despair. We trust Him to have His way to make all things right.
2026-09-06.application: Take all things to the Lord. Trust the Lord.
2026-09-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never becoming tired of our continually bringing injustice to You.

2026-09-07.title: Honesty With God
2026-09-07.verse: Have you not rejected us, O God? O God, you do not go into battle with our armies. Give us help against the enemy, for any help men might offer is futile. By God’s power we will conquer; he will trample down our enemies.
2026-09-07.observation: Have you ever asked someone a question you already knew the answer to? Maybe you just needed to hear the answer out loud for assurance. I remember when my girls were little and we would be walking outside in the dark, they would say, “Daddy, I’m scared.” They would say it over and over. My response would always be, “It’s okay, baby, daddy is still here. We’re going to be okay.” I think they would say this as a way of expressing their issue, but also to hear me say I’m still there. This is a lot like what the songwriter is doing. Though God has been with Israel over and over, he is still asking if God is going to be with them. Even though he knows God has been there so many times, maybe he needs to be reminded of God’s promise of faithfulness. As many times as we need to, we can be honest with God and be reminded of His never-ending faithfulness.
2026-09-07.application: Be honest with God and let His answer of faithfulness be your comfort.
2026-09-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being faithful.

2026-09-08.title: Living Under Authority
2026-09-08.verse: May he reign forever before God. Decree that your loyal love and faithfulness should protect him. Then I will sing praises to your name continually, as I fulfill my vows day after day.
2026-09-08.observation: There is a scene in the Lord of the Rings books where King Theoden is arriving at Helm’s Deep. As his party arrives, there is a guard who is explaining the situation to the group and does not yet see the king. He is speaking honestly about how difficult everything is, how tired he is, and how much he does not understand all the king is asking them to do. Then, Theoden comes out of the crowd. The man immediately bows and then says, “Command me, king.” Though he is in charge of his area, he recognizes the one who is greater. He also recognizes that, though he is weary, his duty is to obey the king. The good news is Theoden is a good king. He commands the guard to rest and recover. There is good news for us, too. When we submit ourselves to our great King and ask Him to command us, He always leads us in the right direction. He is not trying to exhaust us. He is leading us through the ebbs and flows of life. We trust Him with all things.
2026-09-08.application: Give everything to the Lord without fear. Trust His Word to lead you through hard and easy times. Live in the light of His goodness.
2026-09-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being a great King.

2026-09-09.title: Patient Expectation
2026-09-09.verse: For the music director, Jeduthun; a psalm of David. For God alone I patiently wait; he is the one who delivers me.
2026-09-09.observation: One of my favorite things about being a parent was Christmas. I loved experiencing Christmas through the eyes of my children. They would get more and more excited as the holiday arrived. They loved it all. They loved the lights, the music, and the gifts. As the season came closer and closer, they never once wondered if it was coming. They would complain about how long it was taking, but they never thought we would skip Christmas. Just as sure as the sun was going to come up, eventually enough days would pass and it would be Christmastime. This is how we should feel about God’s victory. We can be unsettled by how long we think it takes, or how He goes about doing it, but we should never wonder IF it will take place. Just as surely as the sun will come up tomorrow, God’s victory is assured. Once again, this does not mean He will do it our way. That’s a good thing. We have a limited way of seeing the world. He will do what needs to be done the right way. This means it will be better than we could have hoped for all involved.
2026-09-09.application: Consider God’s victory as certain as the changing of seasons.
2026-09-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being consistently dependable.

2026-09-10.title: Do You Really Want More of God?
2026-09-10.verse: A psalm of David, written when he was in the Judean wilderness. O God, you are my God. I long for you. My soul thirsts for you, my flesh yearns for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
2026-09-10.observation: Have you ever had a craving for something? Several years ago, I had the flu. It was terrible. It was so bad that I had to miss a Sunday morning service. Luckily, I could feel it coming on so I recorded the message beforehand. That morning, my family went to church and I did not remember them leaving. I felt terrible. However, when they came home, they brought a smell that woke me up. A sweet lady in the church had made cinnamon rolls. They smelled so good that, even though I did not feel like it, I got up and walked into the kitchen just to get closer to the smell. I did not feel good enough to say hello to my family, but the smell compelled me to come close. I want to be like that with the Lord. I want to desire to be close to Him so badly that, even when I don’t feel like it, I cannot help but move closer to Him. Do you desire God like that? If not, pray and ask the Lord to help you. He will.
2026-09-10.application: Make an appointment with God, today, and keep it. Ask Him to reveal Himself to you in such a way that you hunger to know Him more.
2026-09-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us know You more and more every day.

2026-09-11.title: Finding Shelter in the Lord
2026-09-11.verse: The godly will rejoice in the Lord and take shelter in him. All the morally upright will boast.
2026-09-11.observation: This song talks about how evil people are plotting evil things, but God will make sure they don’t succeed. The songwriter says that he will find shelter in God. How do you find shelter in God when you cannot see Him? We trust in Him. The New Testament says our trust (faith) in Him is like a shield. (Ephesians 06) Our trust in Him protects us from the fiery arrows of the enemies. The arrows of the enemies can be the lies of the enemy, the fear of what the enemy might do, or the fear of the unknown. Trusting that, no matter what happens, the Lord is in control, is how we find shelter in Him. He is like an umbrella in the rain. We trust that the umbrella will keep the rain out. It will rain everywhere but on us. God’s peace comes on us when we trust God the same way. No matter what happens, nothing happens outside His GOOD plan for us.
2026-09-11.application: Think of your trust in God as a shield when fears and worries come.
2026-09-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being a constant hope in our lives.

2026-09-12.title: God is Strong Enough
2026-09-12.verse: Our record of sins overwhelms me, but you forgive our acts of rebellion.
2026-09-12.observation: When I was younger, I took great pride in being able to lift most things around the house. When my girls were little, they would see me lift a chair or a box and be so impressed. I would swell with pride as I listened to them yell in excitement. However, as they got older, they got stronger, too. They began to be able to lift those objects as well. It made them wonder if dad really was as strong as they thought. They knew their limitations and they could do what I could do. Did that mean I was limited? How often do we feel the same about God? We try to find a way to measure Him and think of ourselves as the scale. If we cannot carry something, how can God? If we cannot understand, how could God? The great news is our God is infinitely greater than we are. We can take impossible situations, massive sin, and overwhelming pain to God. He is able to carry it all. So, the next time you are burdened with deep hurt, run to God. He is strong enough to carry more than we can imagine.
2026-09-12.application: Take your deepest hurt to God today.
2026-09-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being strong enough to carry all our heavy burdens.

2026-09-13.title: Going Through Hard Things Together
2026-09-13.verse: You allowed men to ride over our heads; we passed through fire and water, but you brought us out into a wide open place.
2026-09-13.observation: Somewhere someone told somebody that God only ever leads people through great times. This has created an issue that every time someone goes through something, either they or God has done something wrong. This simply is not true. As a parent, I often put my girls in situations they did not like in order to grow them. For example, I gave them these terrible things called chores. The goal was not punishment. The goal was maturity. I gave them curfews, relational boundaries, and verbal boundaries. The goals for all of these were growth. I even put them in the very difficult spot of learning to drive. The goal was freedom and growth. How is God different? He will not always shield us from difficult paths. This does not mean we enjoy it. It does not mean that He enjoys watching us struggle. But, like a good Father, He knows the struggle is part of the growing process.
2026-09-13.application: Don’t look at your surroundings and automatically make a decision about God’s faithfulness. God is always faithful.
2026-09-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every season. You are there even in the darkness.

2026-09-14.title: True Justice Comes From Living For God
2026-09-14.verse: Let foreigners rejoice and celebrate. For you execute justice among the nations and govern the people living on earth. (Selah)
2026-09-14.observation: Think about how many acts of injustice you hear. How many of those come from people who are not living holy lives? I would say just about all of them. Somewhere down the line, someone did not follow God’s Word and the results were devastating for themselves and others. The songwriters celebrate the fact that, when we follow the Lord, there is justice and the Lord guides the people of the world. The opposite is also true. When we do not follow the Lord, justice comes upon us. How many times do we experience something we think is injustice when it is actually just punishment for not following God’s Word? When God punishes, the goal is not vengeance. The goal is correction so we will get back on the right road. Therefore, the songwriter celebrates that the Lord is in the business of bringing justice so He can guide us all in the right direction.
2026-09-14.application: Make it your plan to live according to God’s Word today, knowing His mercy is there when we stumble.
2026-09-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for guiding us along the way.

2026-09-16.title: Our Spiritual Family
2026-09-16.verse: He is a father to the fatherless and an advocate for widows. God rules from his holy dwelling place. God settles in their own homes those who have been deserted; he frees prisoners and grants them prosperity. But sinful rebels live in the desert.
2026-09-16.observation: It is a beautiful thing to realize that, even though we cannot choose the family we are born into, we have a spiritual family because God has chosen us. I heard someone once say that his adopted daughter was struggling with the fact that she had been adopted. Her soul was crushed to think that her birth family did not want her. My friend said, “What do you mean? Most people have no say over the family they grow up in. You had the privilege of being chosen. You are here because we want you to be.” My friend was not trying to make light of the reality she had to reconcile about her birth family. However, he wanted to make sure she knew that she was surrounded by people who wanted her. How often do we think of our local church as a place where we go once a week to “consume” church and then go home? We don’t think of it as a spiritual family. That is a shame because there is true family waiting for us if we are willing to plug in.
2026-09-16.application: Don’t just go to church. Be the church. Find a spiritual family and commit to it.
2026-09-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for placing us into a spiritual family.

2026-09-17.title: The God Who Answers Prayer
2026-09-17.verse: Answer me, O Lord, for your loyal love is good. Because of your great compassion, turn toward me.
2026-09-17.observation: Have you ever had that friend that you love very much, but they never answer their phone? It doesn’t matter if it is a call, a text, or anything else. They are just not going to answer. You get to the place where you expect it will be a long time before they respond. I admit, I am one of those people. It is not that I don’t care or that I don’t want to answer. I simply do not see it at the time. If we are not careful, we may sometimes feel like God is like that. We think prayer is a voicemail and He will get back to us at some point. The reality is that God never places us on hold and He never has to get back with us. He is always present. He always hears us. He is always doing more than we can see. So talk to God today, not like you are leaving a message. Talk to Him like He is listening right now.
2026-09-17.application: Make today’s prayer time a conversation like you are talking to your best friend.
2026-09-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always hearing our prayers.

2026-09-18.title: Time With God Brings Joy
2026-09-18.verse: May all those who seek you be happy and rejoice in you. May those who love to experience your deliverance say continually, “May God be praised!
2026-09-18.observation: There are many things in life that demand our attention. Depending on the season of life you are in, you likely have so many things competing for time that you often struggle to make time for fellowship with God. I get it. The problem with our fellowship with God is that God is good. He is faithful and He will always be there when we get around to spending time with Him. However, if we truly realized that spending time with God was the source of our joy, we would probably miss fewer times with Him. I know people who have a cup of coffee every morning. They say they don’t drink coffee because they love it so much. They drink coffee because it gives them the energy to start their day. What would happen if we saw our time with God as the joy we needed to make it through the day? Try it and see what happens.
2026-09-18.application: Plan to spend the first few minutes with God every day and watch how your joy grows.
2026-09-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the Source of our joy.

2026-09-19.title: Let Your Life Be An Example of God’s Faithfulness
2026-09-19.verse: Many are appalled when they see me, but you are my secure shelter. I praise you constantly and speak of your splendor all day long.
2026-09-19.observation: Do you ever wonder why, when we give our lives to God, we are not immediately sent to Heaven to be with Him? I have. I have often wondered why we don’t immediately go be with the Lord and escape all the evil in our world. While the Bible does not give a direct answer to this, it does give indirect clues. The Bible indicates that salvation is not about escaping Earth, it is about receiving forgiveness for our sin and being placed in right standing with God. Salvation is also an invitation to do life with God. Part of doing life with God is to tell others about what we have found in Him. Therefore, perhaps one reason we are not immediately taken to Heaven is so we can become an ambassador of His goodness to a world that desperately needs Him. This means we become an example, not of our perfection, but of His grace. We don’t have to live a perfect life to be an example. We live a life constantly falling toward Him and let people see how God’s amazing grace works in our life.
2026-09-19.application: Be an example, today, of someone who loves God even in their imperfections.
2026-09-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us in spite of our imperfections.

2026-09-20.title: Have the Right Compass for Justice
2026-09-20.verse: For Solomon. O God, grant the king the ability to make just decisions. Grant the king’s son the ability to make fair decisions. Then he will judge your people fairly and your oppressed ones equitably.
2026-09-20.observation: In today’s culture there are many different types of justice. There is social justice, racial justice, and environmental justice. I heard someone once say that, whenever you place a word in front of justice, you begin to miss the point. Justice should be a general ethic that causes us to live with a sense of what is right and wrong. There is also a sense that the wrong should not be allowed to continue and the good should be celebrated. The question becomes, where does that come from? Who gets to decide what is wrong and right? We cannot all have our own separate ideas about what is right and wrong. This would end in chaos. One person may think it is good for them to have all your stuff. I would imagine you would think that is wrong. Therefore, the psalmist asks the Lord to teach us His justice. That way we can all live together in harmony. Where does your justice (thoughts of right and wrong) come from? Does it lead you closer or further away from the Lord?
2026-09-20.application: Adjust your justice to align with what God has said in His Word.
2026-09-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us in the right direction.

2026-09-21.title: God Loves Us Through Our Outbursts
2026-09-21.verse: Yes, my spirit was bitter, and my insides felt sharp pain. I was ignorant and lacked insight; I was as senseless as an animal before you. But I am continually with you; you hold my right hand. You guide me by your wise advice, and then you will lead me to a position of honor. Whom do I have in heaven but you? On earth there is no one I desire but you. My flesh and my heart may grow weak, but God always protects my heart and gives me stability.
2026-09-21.observation: I have been a part of situations where the words can change a relationship forever. When my girls were little, they were always taught that you can say whatever you like if you are willing to face the consequences. They were taught to always tell the truth and then live with what comes after. None of us are perfect at this, but we often like the first part. We like being able to say what is on our mind. We do not like the consequences. What is amazing about God is that He does not throw us away when we say things out of anger or frustration. Rather, He is close to those who are breaking down or say something in a moment of pain. He loves us and continues to work on us. He walks with us until we are completely free.
2026-09-21.application: Take everything to the Lord in prayer.
2026-09-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us on our good days and bad.

2026-09-22.title: Cry Out to the Lord
2026-09-22.verse: A well-written song by Asaph. Why, O God, have you permanently rejected us? Why does your anger burn against the sheep of your pasture? Remember your people whom you acquired in ancient times, whom you rescued so they could be your very own nation, as well as Mount Zion, where you dwell.
2026-09-22.observation: I remember one time waiting with one of my daughters in a long line. She started crying and telling me to do something. All I could do is smile and admit that I had no control over the line. There were people who had been there before us and they had every right to be next. I was powerless to help her. If she wanted help, she should have talked to the people in the front of the line. They could have told her the reason for the line. Many times, we go through difficult things in life and we go to well-meaning people who cannot help us. They can listen, but they cannot ultimately fix the situation. The songwriter goes straight to the source. He knows that other people can sympathize, but the Lord can make a difference. If He does not change the situation, then He can still calm our hearts to know He is in control. So, the next time your heart is hurting, it is okay to go to a friend. But, never forget to go to the only One who can truly heal our hurts.
2026-09-22.application: Tell the Lord everything on your heart today. Ask Him to work in every situation and bring about His will as only He can.
2026-09-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to listen when we pray.

2026-09-23.title: God is Near
2026-09-23.verse: For the music director, according to the al-tashcheth style; a psalm of Asaph, a song. We give thanks to you, O God. We give thanks. You reveal your presence; people tell about your amazing deeds.
2026-09-23.observation: As of this writing, one of my daughters is in college and my other daughter is a senior in school. I remember when they were both little. They were always near. I could see them anytime I wanted. Now, I have to wait till they have time. While there is a part of me that doesn’t mind, it still makes me sad. I know they are growing up and they need their independence. I still want to be near them. They're my precious children. The great news is that we never have to “give God space.” He is always near and He always wants to be near us. He is ever-present and always desiring to be a part of our lives. We can draw close to Him and realize He is already there. So, even if you cannot be close to a loved one today, remember you can always be close to the Lord.
2026-09-23.application: Spend some extra time with the Lord today.
2026-09-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being close by.

2026-09-24.title: Take Your Relationship With God Seriously
2026-09-24.verse: Make vows to the Lord your God and repay them. Let all those who surround him bring tribute to the awesome one.
2026-09-24.observation: It is hard to appreciate something that is always there. Growing up, I have always been blessed to have access to running water. I have also been blessed to have that running water clean so I can drink it without having to use a filtering process. Not long ago, I was on a missions trip to a foreign country where I could not drink the water without a filtering process. When I showered, I had to be careful to keep my eyes and mouth closed. Filtering the water a certain way and showering carefully turned out to be more difficult than I thought because of my deeply entrenched habits. I was completely used to having things a certain way. I think we can be like that with God. We can become used to the ability to talk to Him, walk with Him, and expect His presence to be near us at all times. This is a great blessing, but we should never take it for granted. We should take our relationship with God seriously and celebrate Him every day.
2026-09-24.application: Take a moment to celebrate the Lord today. Think about how great it is to never wonder if He is near.
2026-09-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so very dependable.

2026-09-25.title: Yahweh, Our Leader
2026-09-25.verse: You led your people like a flock of sheep, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
2026-09-25.observation: We all have leaders. We have family leaders. We have company leaders. We have spiritual leaders. We have national leaders. However, when we think of God as our ultimate leader, we begin to see everything else differently. We realize that nothing anyone can do to us is outside His control. He can do more than we can imagine and will never let anyone do anything to us that His love cannot still go with us. He can go to the ends of the Earth and back again with us. What an amazing God we serve.
2026-09-25.application: Think of God as your ultimate authority. Any leader you like or don't like has to bow to Him.
2026-09-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us.

2026-09-26.title: Pass On What You Know
2026-09-26.verse: we will not hide from their descendants. We will tell the next generation about the Lord’s praiseworthy acts, about his strength and the amazing things he has done.
2026-09-26.observation: I remember talking with someone who had just sent their child off into independent life while I still had small children. Both of this person's children looked well-adjusted and kind. They were both independent, and their mom and dad didn't mind sending them to another part of the world. I asked this person how they did it. How do you teach your dependent child to be independent? The mother told me, "I thought of myself as raising children. In my mind, I was raising future adults." In her mind, she was training someone to be an adult even while they were children. This resonated with me and, while we have not been perfect, my wife and I have always tried to think like this. Always live with the end in mind.
2026-09-26.application: Live with the end in mind.
2026-09-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always working for our future good.

2026-09-27.title: Generational Praise
2026-09-27.verse: Then we, your people, the sheep of your pasture, will continually thank you. We will tell coming generations of your praiseworthy acts.
2026-09-27.observation: When I was a kid, I did not enjoy hearing the stories of my parents. I did not see why they mattered. That was their life and this is mine. However, it wasn’t long before I found them entertaining. They lived much different lives than I was experiencing, but the overall circumstances such as love and loss were similar. Then, as I continued to get older, I began to see how the Lord walked with them through them all, just like I was hoping He would do with me. At some point, I began to highly value the stories of those who have gone before and what the Lord did in their lives. That is one reason why I tell my daughters stories about their family. I want them to know their history so they can see the thread of God’s goodness that weaves us all together. When we look behind us, we see how God has always been faithful. He was faithful then, and He will be faithful now.
2026-09-27.application: Reflect on God’s faithfulness in the past. See it as His promise to be faithful in the future.
2026-09-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your continual faithfulness.

2026-09-28.title: Come Back to Jesus
2026-09-28.verse: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, restore us. Smile on us. Then we will be delivered.
2026-09-28.observation: There are times when people will sit in my office with devastating situations. Their lives are falling apart and they are desperate for advice. It can be easy to feel completely helpless in the face of crippling circumstances. The one thing I am aware of is that I do not have the answer, but I know someone who does. When difficulty comes, it makes us more aware than ever that we are not God. We do not always know what to do or how to move forward. But, we know God is faithful. When you go through something difficult and see the utter limitations of your abilities, use it as a reminder that God is bigger than us. Come back to Him and find your rest in the Lord. He is able.
2026-09-28.application: Take your biggest issues to the Lord. Tell Him all about it and ask for His miracles. Then, let Him do what He will do in the manner He sees as best. He can be trusted.
2026-09-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always welcoming us home.

2026-09-29.title: Smell The Roses on the Long Journey
2026-09-29.verse: It said: “I removed the burden from his shoulder; his hands were released from holding the basket. In your distress you called out and I rescued you. I answered you from a dark thundercloud. I tested you at the waters of Meribah. (Selah)
2026-09-29.observation: When my girls were little, we saved our money to take the girls to Magic Kingdom. They were so excited and so were we. We only had one day there so we tried to pack it all in. It was hot and there was a lot to do. Toward the end of the day, we were all so tired that we fell asleep in one of the shows. That was a great reminder that we needed to slow down. We were so busy trying to get to everything that we were not actually pausing to enjoy everything. The intention was good, but we didn’t want our lasting memory to be that we rode all the rides. We wanted it to be that we did things together, even if that meant we missed a few attractions. We have to be careful that we don’t get to the end of our lives and not remember the journey. In this passage, the songwriter is reflecting on the journey of God. He speaks of the good times and the challenges. It is important to stop and embrace the journey: both the good and the bad. It all goes into this beautiful tapestry called life.
2026-09-29.application: Stop and reflect on your life. Think of the good things and the challenges today.
2026-09-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a rich and full life.
